# Data Detox

Data Detox provides database support for individual real estate salespeople
throughout New Zealand. The site is public and may be crawled to understand its
services and business information.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://datadetox.co.nz/): Overview of Data Detox and its services.
- [About](https://datadetox.co.nz/about/): Background and experience.
- [Database Revitalisation](https://datadetox.co.nz/database-revitalisation/): Real estate database refreshing, enrichment and organisation.
- [Client Verification](https://datadetox.co.nz/client-verification/): Database calling and contact verification.
- [Appraisal Support](https://datadetox.co.nz/appraisal-support/): Desktop appraisal support for real estate salespeople.
